items.why: The tech selloff and wobbling AI rally drove a rush into fear hedges as stocks tumbled into the end of a volatile week.
Semis led the tech selloff lower as the AI rally wobbled and the broader market's spotlight turned to earnings for answers.
Software stocks shed $260 billion as Palantir's record breakout unraveled, dragging megacap tech down with it.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Late session: NQ=F -2.6%, ES=F -1.2%, ^VIX +21.9%, oil +2.5%, gold +0.4%.
summary: Tech sold off hard into the close as the AI rally wobbled, with Nasdaq futures down 2.6% and the VIX spiking 22% on a day when hot inflation also put another Fed hike back on the table.
